blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Senator-Judge Joel Villanueva on Friday expressed alarm that Cale88 Foods Corp. supposedly has only two employees, despite reporting over P150 million in revenue and over P6 million in losses. READ: Sara Duterte trial: Witness reveals CALE88, Gencorp balances, 2022-2025 Cale88 is among Vice President Sara Duterte’s business interests being tackled before the Senate impeachment court, particularly its links to her husband, Manases Carpio. During the 37th day of Duterte’s impeachment trial, Villanueva cited Cale88’s general information sheet, which showed that only two employees were employed by the company in 2025—while no employees at all were listed in 2023 […]...
